title: Sadiyon se Ek Raat
body:
kehte hai ye imame zaman ay karbala
sadiyon se ek raat bhi soya nahi hoo mai
<<DIVIDER>>
jee khol kar hussain ko roya nahi hoo mai
sadiyon se ek raat bhi soya nahi hoo mai
<<DIVIDER>>
doobi hui lahoo mein hai shabbir ki jabeen
abbas o qasim o ali akbar bhi ab nahi
karti hai bain saath mere fatema yehi
aansu agar bahaun to beh jaaye ye zameen
sadiyon se ek raat bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehsoos kar raha hoo bahattar ke zakhm ko
logon mere bhi karb pe marham koi rakho
pursa na sirf saare shaheedon ka mujhko do
bazaar e shaam ki bhi zara taaziyat karo
sadiyon se ek raat bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tapti zameen pe hurr e dilawar ki laash hai
saahil pe ab bhi saani e hyder ki laash hai
ye kapkapati qasim e muztar ki laash hai
asghar ki laash ye hai wo akbar ki laash hai
sadiyon se ek raat bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
maalik mujhe yazeed se izne jidaal de
abid ke dil se shaam ka manzar nikaal de
zehra ke zakhm zakhm ka ab indemaal de
asghar ko ab rabab ke jhoole mein daal de
sadiyon se ek raat bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
apno ka haal dekh ke phat'ta hai ye jigar
quran saja ke rakhe hai har ek taaq par
saydaniya jo phirti hai majlis mein nange sar
girya bahot karta hoo aamaal dekh kar
sadiyon se ek raat bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
nashe mein hirs o jehl ke tum log choor ho
kirdar aur amal mein bahot be-shaoor ho
mai tum se to qareeb hoo tum mujhse door ho
tayyar tum nahi ho to kaise zahoor ho
sadiyon se ek raat bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
raasit usool deen ke har ek pal karo
logon furu e deen pe poora amal karo
hirs o hawaas e nafs se jang o jadal karo
mai chaahta zahoor hoo mushkil ko hal karo
sadiyon se ek raat bhi...
author: Qamar Hasnain
